parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 metabolism records where enzyme_name is CYP1A2. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain the substrate compound name. Join compound_structures on the substrate molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary on parent_molregno to obtain the parent compound name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Sort the results by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name.
